outlook: All 9 seats on the Nov 3 ballot; 5 contested (D2, D5, D6, D7, D9). Four seats settled at qualifying (Gerald/Gerard LeBlanc D1, Chad Nugent D8, plus Kriss Fairbairn Fortunato and newcomer Alice Hoyt per WWNO; districts for the last two unverified). Incumbents challenged: Michael Pedalino (D6), Ralph 'Rem' Brandt (D7, board president as of 2024; current officer status unverified), Kevin Delahoussaye (D9). Runoffs Dec 12 if no majority (D5 has 3 candidates). No 2026 Jefferson school millage found; Superintendent James Gray (since 2020) contract status for 2026-27 unverified.
impact: Jefferson hosts four Star sites (TH Harris Middle, Marrero Middle, Meisler Middle, Stella Worley Middle), the largest single-district footprint, so this board controls a multi-site contract renewal, the superintendent, and the budget. Even a 2-3 seat swing in a 9-member board can shift the majority.
result_note: 5 of 9 seats contested; 4 decided unopposed at qualifying (sources disagree slightly on which).

office: East Baton Rouge Parish School Board
outlook: All 9 seats up; 7 contested. Board President Shashonnie Steward (D4) faces Tebbe Jackson; VP Cliff Lewis (D5) and Patrick Martin (D9) unopposed. Superintendent LaMont Cole was indicted in Aug 2026 and returned to work; board kept him but passed an 8-0 two-signature contract rule (Aug 20). Cole's contract runs to mid-2028, but a new board could move on leave/buyout. Open-seat races in D1 and D7 (no incumbent marked). No EBR school tax proposition found for Nov 3 or Dec 12 (2025 renewals already passed).
impact: EBR hosts Northdale Alternative Magnet Academy and likely the 'Broadmoor' site (Broadmoor High, Baton Rouge; parish unverified, could instead be Broadmoor Middle Lab in Caddo). With the superintendent under indictment, a board majority shift here is the highest superintendent-risk scenario in the group.
result_note: 7 of 9 contested; board president challenged; superintendent indicted Aug 2026.

impact: General-fund-type operating millage for the district that funds Arthur F. Smith Middle and Carter C. Raymond JH; a failure would pressure discretionary contracts like Star.

office: Franklin Parish School Board 15.51-mill tax renewal (10 years)
outlook: On the Dec 12, 2026 ballot after Franklin Parish voters rejected all six parish propositions, including school millage (an 8.14-mill school renewal among them), on May 16, 2026. 15.51 mills, about $1.9M/yr, for maintenance and repairs at all parish schools. If it fails the millage expires.
impact: Funds facilities at the schools housing Crowville School and Fort Necessity Middle Star sites; a second failure squeezes the district budget that pays for Star.
result_note: Second attempt after May 2026 defeat; anti-tax turnout risk.
